sentences.en: This sofa is in no way comfortable to sit in.
sentences.zh: 这个沙发坐着一点也不舒服。

sentences.en: Grandmother looks very comfortable in that chair beside the fire.
sentences.zh: 奶奶坐在火炉旁的那把椅子上看起来很惬意。

sentences.en: The bed I slept in last night wasn't very comfortable.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚睡的床不是很舒服。
